meta_description:
663 likes, 67 comments - nomadicmatt on October 13, 2026: "Save these spots for your next trip to NYC! These are some of the places I take my friends to when they visit.

And here are some other incredible places I didn’t have photos for but are 100000% worth going to:

Thai Villa (Thai)
Left Bank (French)
Jadis (French)
Semma (Indian)
Casa Mono (Spanish)
Tasty Dumpling (Chinese)
Veselka (Ukrainian)
Lilli and Loo (Chinese)
Flex Mussels (Seafood)
Kaia Wine Bar (South African)
John’s on Bleecker (Pizza)
Kin Ramen (Ramen)
Yama (Sushi)

For more tips and restaurant suggestions, comment NYCGUIDE (one word!!!!) and I’ll send you a link to my free guide to NYC.

#nyc #nyctravel #nycfood #newyorkcity #newyorklife".
